svg.title: Civic-Alert flow as built
svg.desc: Flowchart of what the Civic-Alert code actually does: an ElevenLabs voice conversation, three ways a call can end, server classification and geocoding, drafts, merges or dropped reports, saving to a JSON file, reading the result back, a Tier 1 review queue, and one Daytona sandbox per live case that is deleted when the case resolves.
svg.text: ↻ repeats each turn, at most 2 questions
